output.headline: Health IT strategics and sponsors with existing sub-sector platforms form the buyer universe for this national target; pricing at the median of 21.4x EV/EBITDA is defensible.
sentences: Call Evolent Health first, then Blackstone, because Evolent has 3 sub-sector deals and has closed $325M; the order among the five sponsors is close to a tie, with back-test hit rate of 28% against 20% random [E:tier1, E:sponsor_ordering].

A median multiple of 21.4x EV/EBITDA is defensible because 25.0% margin is above the comparable median but not top quarter; Evolent, Blackstone, Francisco Partners and Epic Systems can pay it comfortably [E:valuation, E:tier1].
The review removed Ciox Health and Cerner (Oracle) as now owned by Datavant and Oracle, and set aside Change Healthcare as part of UnitedHealth Group [E:review].
Most buyers share a diversification and technology-capability motive, seen in 100% of 50 Health IT deals, followed by high growth at 90%, so lead the pitch with those themes [E:motives].
